{{main article|2022 WTA Tour}}

The WTA 1000 Mandatory and non-Mandatory tournaments, which are part of the [[WTA 1000 tournaments]], make up the elite tour for professional women's [[tennis]] organised by the [[Women's Tennis Association|WTA]] called the [[WTA Tour]]. There are four 1000 Mandatory tournaments: Indian Wells, Miami, Madrid and Beijing and five non-Mandatory tournaments: Doha, Rome, Canada, Cincinnati, and Guadalajara, the last of which was held starting this year as a substitute for Wuhan.<ref>{{Cite web |title=2022 Tournaments {{!}} WTA Official |url=https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/2022 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20220920193433/https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/2022|archive-date=2022-09-20 |website=Women's Tennis Association |language=en}}</ref>
